matched_records: Purdue GIS OBJECTID 310 / HNLY: Bill and Sally Hanley Hall
identity.confidence: Building identity is high. The evidence conflict is now interpreted as different outlines: Purdue GIS OBJECTID 310 for walls and OSM way 283275000 for roof/eave overhang. A current georeferenced Indiana orthophoto overlay supports this: OSM perimeter lies outside the Purdue GIS perimeter along most visible edges and traces the larger roof outline. Residual source semantics and survey uncertainty remain.

provenance: See sources/source_catalog.json for raw provider snapshots, dates, CRS, methods, metrics, and limitations. Added the Indiana 2022–2025 statewide orthophoto export and georeferenced overlay used to distinguish the wall ring from the roof/eave ring.

after.structural_shell_footprint: Purdue GIS OBJECTID 310 polygon; 96 vertices. Reopened model ring max coordinate error 0.000033 m; mesh/source IoU 0.999999.
after.roof_eave_outline: OSM way 283275000 roof/eave perimeter; 29 vertices. Reopened model ring max coordinate error 0.000031 m; mesh/source IoU 0.999999.

placement_and_plan.source: Official Purdue University campus GIS OBJECTID 310 (HNLY) for structural wall line; OSM way 283275000 for outer roof/eave line; Indiana Current Orthophotography crop for visual relationship.
placement_and_plan.method: Transformed EPSG:4326 source rings with project local approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040. The GIS wall polygon is used for vertical shell. The OSM ring is retained only as the larger projected roof/eave boundary.
placement_and_plan.footprint_comparison: Purdue GIS wall polygon area 1184.16 m2; OSM/eave polygon area 1455.00 m2; intersection-over-union 0.8085; boundary Hausdorff 3.55 m; centroid offset 1.24 m. Aerial overlay shows OSM mostly on outer eaves, GIS on the inset wall edge. The official GIS 34,064 sq-ft attribute and three-floor count make GIS the more plausible wall ring, but are not a surveyed wall-line proof.
placement_and_plan.orientation: Kept official GIS orientation; location is in campus world coordinates and footprint center aligns with both source polygons. Current shell does not apply rotation or arbitrary rescale.
placement_and_plan.residual_uncertainty: Exact survey date and wall/eave semantics are not supplied for either polygon. Orthophoto is statewide 2022–2025; exact tile date unavailable. Some eaves, shadows and trees obscure edges.

vertical_geometry.floor_count: Three floors per Purdue Office of Emergency Preparedness plan, revision 2026-03-31.
vertical_geometry.height_status: Estimated. Official floor count plus three-floor story structure support floor organization only; no measured elevation, section or roof survey found. Total ridge and eave levels remain estimates.
vertical_geometry.roof: Shallow hipped roof massing spans the larger OSM roof/eave outline and rises to the estimated 16.08 m inner ridge plane. Current orthophoto shows multiple sloping roof planes and the HHS photograph shows a dark projecting eave. Roof pitch, ridge divisions and exact elevations remain generalized.

materials_and_features: glazed entry bay on probable playground-facing side
facade.source: Purdue HHS photograph captioned MCDLS children play outside of Hanley Hall (published 2026-09-24); Indiana 2022–2025 current orthophoto crop for roof layout and courtyard/playground context.
facade.status: Brick, ground glazing, upper windows and roof edge are visible in the Purdue photo. The current orthophoto supports the broad roof-plan shape. The north/playground-side entry bay location is inferred from photo/playground context, not georeferenced; exact entrance placement, roof facets and all unphotographed elevations remain uncertain.

edits: Replaced the OSM-sized wall extrusion with Purdue GIS OBJECTID 310 structural wall footprint after overlay review showed the OSM ring tracking the larger eave/roof projection outside the GIS wall line.
Retained OSM way 283275000 as the outer roof/eave plan outline, consistent with current aerial imagery.
Changed the roof from a flat cap to a shallow hipped roof massing with a modest inset high plane; pitch and ridge height remain estimates because no elevation/section was found.

Added a contextual glazed entry bay on the probable playground-facing north side using the visible ground-floor glazing/entrance in the Purdue HHS photograph and adjacent playground context. The photo is not georeferenced, so exact door side remains uncertain.
Kept the three-floor arrangement from Purdue OEP; preserved brick, glazing, windows and light facade bands from the Purdue photo.

validation.reopened: Passed: saved .blend reopened directly in Blender 5.2; one expected scene, one expected collection, one mesh object. Saved file contains no startup cube, camera, light or other stray scene object.
validation.source_shell_check: Passed: all 96 Purdue GIS OBJECTID 310 wall vertices present with max coordinate error 0.000033 m. Mesh/source wall polygon IoU 0.999999.
validation.roof_eave_check: Passed: all 29 OSM eave outline vertices present with max coordinate error 0.000031 m. Mesh/source roof-plan IoU 0.999999.
validation.footprint_reconciliation: Purdue GIS is now modeled as wall shell; OSM is modeled as larger roof/eave projection. Source outline differences preserved: GIS 1184.16 m2, OSM 1455.00 m2, wall/eave IoU 0.80849, centroid offset 1.235 m. The current orthophoto overlay supports the interpretation but is not a survey.
validation.portability: Passed: expected collection exports a single joined mesh; no modifiers, external images, or linked libraries. The saved file has one scene containing only Hanley Hall.
validation.render: Rendered and inspected audit/massing_hanley_hall_c8a4551/renders/hanley_hall_facade.png and hanley_entry_review.png. Source overlay: review/hanley_current_aerial_footprint_overlay.jpg.

independent_grade: R2 review scored 6.0/10. This repair responds to the footprint conflict by modeling GIS as walls and OSM as roof/eave projection, adds a contextual entrance and hipped roof with remaining uncertainties documented. Fresh independent review requested.
